about_short_description.short_description: Raycast is a Productivity Tools company that provides a command bar software to assist developers control their tools as well as AI tools.

product.name: Raycast
product.description: A keyboard-driven launcher for accessing applications, files, system controls, scripts, notes, calculations, window management, and integrated third-party tools.

product.name: Raycast AI
product.description: An operating-system-integrated AI assistant for web-enabled questions, conversational help, and custom AI commands that automate repetitive tasks.

product.name: Raycast Pro
product.description: A paid Raycast subscription tier that extends the core launcher with additional productivity and AI capabilities.

product.name: Raycast Store
product.description: A marketplace for discovering and installing extensions that add commands and integrations for productivity, engineering, design, writing, and other workflows.

product.name: Raycast Extension API
product.description: A development platform for building and publishing Raycast extensions using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Raycast’s built-in UI components.

product.name: Raycast Teams
product.description: An organizational Raycast offering for deploying and managing Raycast usage across teams.
